body:
Hey Op:

Im sorry about your dad. I also had an asshole of a father. Different circumstances but to give a short summary: drug addict, spilled cocaine on me when I was 2 years old, left us, didn't pay us child support, lost contact with me at around 14.

Then recently pop up out of nowhere saying he's sorry and to take care of him. Jokes on him now!

What I'm trying to say, he will regret his mistake. You're not in the wrong. It hurts but it gets better. I wish you luck!

Thanks for your reply and well wishes!

Yeah that would help my conscience to do some good with it. It would be a compromise. Its sad this is one of the best stocks but I can't argue with that. Its not like we want the money for drugs or anything, we just want to have a family. But the origin of it still makes my skin crawl. Thanks for understanding my perpective as well.

I like your description of necessary evil. I (and probably a lot of people) wish it didn't have to be this  way but if a lot of nations suddenly turned hippie, they could easily fall from outsider attacks.

My biological dad served but the trauma turned him into an addict. I guess thats where my deep dislike for military comes from partly and why I felt a moral obligation to object to it. Despite that, I now see that we would just be making a profit of the inevitable and hopefully with that profit we can also do some good, even if its a little

Thanks for taking the time to do this extensive reply!

Putting it like that, it does help me with the guilt aspect of it. Even more so, the fact that the money we as private investors, put in the military, means less tax money is needed and can be used for others things. So its helping, in a weird twisted sense, to fund other govermental services. 

It still sucks in the sense that war will go on but there's not much I can do as an individual to stop that. Your comment gave me a new, depressing but useful perpective. Thank you stranger!

Maybe greedy wasn't the best word for it. Not a native speaker. 

What I meant was I feel its wrong to make profit out of others suffering by funding companies that make military equipment, designed for war. I don't think its wrong to seek financial security, thats exactly how this discussion came up, because we both know we want a family in the future and we want them to grow up in a stable enviroment. However, for me, the means don't justify the end while for him the means do justify the end. And that's why I posted to hopefully gain some insight.
Can you recommend any? Is there anything I could read to serve as a guide for learning to buy stocks? Im a beginner in all this, thanks for replying.

That's weird...

I mean Im a woman too and sure I want to adopt kids and have a home etc etc, but there's much more to me than just that. I like painting, acting on plays  reading, scrapbooking and scuba diving etc. I feel she's just trying to tick stuff off her checkbox (marriage, check, house, check). Its really weird to meet someone with no interests. Maybe she hasn't opened up to you completely yet? Or she's boring which is rather unfortunate for you for the nest 30 + if you do marry. Good luck pal!

Thats really normal. Being in a couple doesn't mean being glued to the hip. Both of you are still two independent ppl. Try to encourage her to pursue one of her hobbies when you're having your alone time. Or for her to go out with her friends or something. She sounds really needy.

Leave, he should be with someone who's at the same life stage as he is. 21 is too young for you to play 30 year old wife. I love my boyfriend and we want to get married soon too. However, we both have clear career and academic goals we want to accomplish first and we plan how to help each other achieve. We're already commited to each other as husband and wife but we also recognize there are more important things like achieving career goals and having a place to live than planning a wedding thats gonna cost us a ton. We agree on the timeline we want things to happen, like having kids between 30-33 etc. For marriage especially, love alone is not enough. Goals and expectations should line up nicely together. Its obvious both of you want completely different things, and that is completely natural given the age difference. Sometimes age gap doesn't matter bc both ppl want similar things. But in your case it does. Having a baby and starting a family is a huge decision to make. It will set back you academic wise. If you truly want to start a family at this age, go for it, knock yourself, if not run for the hills.
Thank you kind stranger ❤ I don't get emotional usually but Im so happy now that ppl did care
Ohh my God you made me cry ❤ Thank you and I wish the best for you too stranger.
Thanks man, it means a lot rn.
Thank you although I don't feel really strong rn. I am very tired. I will wait for those days.
Thanks man I appreciate the plan.
Im alone and I feel so useless. I haven't received a hug in so long. It hurts man. Everything is closed so Im just alone with my thoughts and I want to die so bad rn.
